item.title: AMFI Forms web app
item.description:
During my Erasmus+ internship at Go Project in Italy, I built a website for AMFI. It replaces paper internship forms with online forms.

How it works

  • AMFI adds teachers and students and fills in the main information.
  • The student writes a weekly log of the internship.
  • The company tutor writes comments and the final assessment.

Tools

  • Python and Django
  • HTML and CSS
  • Git and GitHub

Code: github.com/Marina-Kapula/amfi

item.title: About
item.description:
Hi! I’m Maryna Kapula, an ICT student at Esedu (South Savo Vocational College) in Mikkeli, Finland. I’m learning web development, and I’m especially interested in design.

Before IT, I studied to be an artist-restorer at Tulchyn College of Culture in Ukraine. My background in art is where my interest in design comes from.

Right now I’m doing an Erasmus+ internship at Go Project in Italy.

Experience

Intern (Erasmus+)
